title: Pixel Valley
description: A animal crossing & Stardew valley inspried game built in Godot

title: Personal Portfolio Site
description: This site. Built from scratch with vanilla HTML, CSS and JS. Initially self-hosted on a home server exposed via Cloudflare Tunnel, then migrated to GitHub Pages.

title: Home Assistant via Cloudflare Tunnel
description: Securely exposed a self-hosted Home Assistant instance to the internet via a cloudflare tunnel with zero-trust access implemented for remote control of home automation.

title: AI Game Assistant
description: Built an AI game assistant with OCR, Voice command recognition and gamesave analysis to provide accurate and spoiler free lore hands free whilst playing the game. E.g: QuestLog, who is Paarthurnax?

title: DF-Portait
description: Reverse engineered dwarf fortress's sprite compositor to get accurate charachter portaits through available DFHack data. Originally integrated in DF-Story Teller, made standalone and open source for use in other projects and the community

title: DF-Story Teller
description: AI Driven dwarf fortress story generator. Legends mode reader, live event viewer and dfhack integration used together to generate a narrative that fits your world
